title: Kale Chaat Mexican Salad
description: A spicy and flavorful twist on a traditional Mexican salad, featuring crispy kale and a tangy chaat masala dressing.

ingredients.name: kale
ingredients.amount: 4 cups, stems removed and discarded, leaves chopped

ingredients.name: 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and finely chopped

instructions: In a large pan, heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over medium heat.
Add cumin seeds and coriander seeds, and let them sizzle for 1 minute.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3-4 minutes, until softened.
Add the chopped kale and sauté for 2-3 minutes, until slightly wilted.
Add the garam masala and chaat masala, and stir to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lime juice and remaining 6 tablespoons of olive oil.
Pour the dressing over the kale mixture, and toss to combine.
Stir in the chopped jalapeno pepper.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the salad warm or at room temperature.
